value.rationale: A graph-theoretically natural scarce-color optimization in two-step rainbow routing: every feasible pair is rainbow-connected using minimal secondary-color edges, and the full family of extremizers is determined by permutations with cycles of length >=3. The structural count is not implied by ordinary rc-number results and yields a genuine exact infinite enumerator.
